causal_clock.crown_target: unchanged Opening Edge v3 target produced at a completed XSP five-minute close
causal_clock.permission_observation: the next completed XSP and SPY five-minute close visible to the real :02/:07 timer invocation

causal_clock.wait: exactly one further natural five-minute invocation
causal_clock.wait_terminal: admit only if opposition cleared; otherwise revoke

frozen_law.path_inputs: target-signed return, slope, and slope-velocity over completed 5/15/30/60/120-minute evidence; at least three path horizons and two velocity horizons
frozen_law.volatility_inputs: ATR ratio is recorded; ATR velocity and acceleration jointly label EXPANDING, CONTRACTING, or TRANSITIONAL
frozen_law.spy_pressure_reference: volume and normalized true range are ranked only against the same RTH five-minute slot in the preceding 63 sessions, with 21 required

spy_pressure_levels.ORDINARY: neither joint rank reaches the elevated band and neither one-sided rank reaches the shock band
spy_pressure_levels.ONE_SIDED: volume or true range rank is at least 0.95 without joint confirmation

frozen_law.revoke: dual authoritative opposition, pressure-confirmed opposition, or opposition that persists through the single wait
frozen_law.wait: one authoritative source or an opposed path whose directional velocity is cresting/decelerating
frozen_law.admit_now: no authoritative fresh opposition, or opposition cleared after the single wait
forbidden: use current/future same-slot observations in a percentile
use ES or MES as a required input without live entitlement
change sizing, capital, execution ladder, exit, flip, or order type
